node.statement: Write (C_i,e_i,delta_i,a_i) for witnesses of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation and (C_o,e_o,delta_o,a_o) for witnesses of lem-maincb-reset-output-typing, after the common upstream e_it,K_disp,K_floor,epsilon_max^cb,delta_max^cb,c0^0 have been fixed. Define C=max{C_i,C_o}, e=min{e_i,e_o}, delta=min{delta_i,delta_o}, and a=min{a_i,a_o}; these are respectively positive finite and positive. For either x in {i,o}, C>=C_x and e<=e_x, delta<=delta_x, a<=a_x. Therefore, for every D>=1, the combined coefficient guard W.c0_cb>=max{c0^0,K_floor,C*(K_floor+1)} implies the x-guard with C_x, while the combined radius guard W.r_reset<=min{epsilon_max^cb,delta_max^cb/D,e_it/(D+1),e,delta/max{1,K_floor},a/((1+K_disp)*D),[2*(1+K_disp)*D]^{-1}} implies the x-radius guard term by term. Thus (C,e,delta,a) is a valid witness tuple for both imported reset lemmas. Instantiate lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger with this tuple, legitimately viewed as a witness of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation; its fixed output W consequently satisfies the output-typing guards at D=D_*. Node 1.2.3.1 supplies all remaining premises: D_*>=1, 0<=t_2<=W.r_reset, epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon<=t_2, A_R=A_{U_{r+1}} extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra, and u_2:M_{r+1}->A_R a bijective extended D_*t_2-inclusion with unit error at most D_*t_2. Universal instantiation of lem-maincb-reset-output-typing now yields one and the same v_{U_{r+1}} with the asserted defect and unit bounds, unchanged typing data, and extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_R-isomorphism status.
